text_en: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,
text_cn: 奉我们的救主天主，和作我们希望的基督耶稣的命，作基督耶稣宗徒的保禄，

text_en: To Timothy, my loyal child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
text_cn: 致书给在信德上作我真子的弟茂德。愿恩宠、仁慈与平安，由天主父和我们的主基督耶稣赐与你！

text_en: I urge you, as I did when I was on my way to Macedonia, to remain in Ephesus so that you may instruct certain people not to teach any different doctrine,
text_cn: 当我往马其顿去的时候，曾请求你留在厄弗所，为的是要你训令某些人，不要讲异端道理，

text_en: and not to occupy themselves with myths and endless genealogies that promote speculations rather than the divine training that is known by faith.
text_cn: 也不要探求无稽的传说，以及无穷尽的祖谱，因为这些事只会激起争辩，对于天主所立的那基于信德的救世计划，毫无益处。

text_en: But the aim of such instruction is love that comes from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith.
text_cn: 这训令的目的就是爱，即由纯洁的心、光明磊落的良心和真诚的信仰所发出的爱；

text_en: Some people have deviated from these and turned to meaningless talk,
text_cn: 但有些人离开这些而转向了空谈；

text_en: desiring to be teachers of the law, without understanding either what they are saying or the things about which they make assertions.
text_cn: 他们愿意充当法学士，却不明白自己所说和所主张的是什么事。

text_en: Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it legitimately.
text_cn: 我们知道法律原是好的，只要人用得合法；

text_en: This means understanding that the law is laid down not for the innocent but for the lawless and disobedient, for the godless and sinful, for the unholy and profane, for those who kill their father or mother, for murderers,
text_cn: 我们也知道法律不是为义人立的，而是为叛逆和不服从的，为不虔敬和犯罪的，为不敬神和渎圣的，为弑(shì)父弑母的，为杀人的，

text_en: fornicators, sodomites, slave traders, liars, perjurers, and whatever else is contrary to the sound teaching
text_cn: 为犯奸淫的，为行男色的，为拐卖人口的，为说谎言的，为发虚誓的，并为其他相反健全道理的事而立的；

text_en: that conforms to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which he entrusted to me.
text_cn: 这道理是按着真福的天主所托给我的光荣福音而宣讲的。

text_en: I am grateful to Christ Jesus our Lord, who has strengthened me, because he judged me faithful and appointed me to his service,
text_cn: 我感谢那赐我能力的我们的主基督耶稣，因为他认为我忠信，就派定了我服役。

text_en: even though I was formerly a blasphemer, a persecutor, and a man of violence. But I received mercy because I had acted ignorantly in unbelief,
text_cn: 原先我是个亵渎者、迫害者和施暴者；但是我蒙受了怜悯，因为我当时是在不信之中，出于无知而作了那些事。

text_en: and the grace of our Lord overflowed for me with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
text_cn: 然而我们主的恩宠对我格外丰厚，使我在耶稣基督内有了信和爱。

text_en: The saying is sure and worthy of full acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners—of whom I am the foremost.
text_cn: 这话是确实的，值得完全接纳：就是基督耶稣到世界上来，是为拯救罪人；而我就是其中的魁首。

text_en: But for that very reason I received mercy, so that in me, as the foremost, Jesus Christ might display the utmost patience, making me an example to those who would come to believe in him for eternal life.
text_cn: 但是我所以蒙受了怜悯，是为使基督耶稣在我这个魁首身上，显示他的完全坚忍，为给将来信靠他而获永生的人一个榜样。

text_en: To the King of the ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
text_cn: 愿尊崇和光荣归于万世的君王，那不死不灭，不可见的惟一天主，于无穷世之世！阿们。

text_en: I am giving you these instructions, Timothy, my child, in accordance with the prophecies made earlier about you, so that by following them you may fight the good fight,
text_cn: 我儿弟茂德！我根据以前指着你所说过的那些预言，把这训令委托给你，为叫你藉此打这场好仗，

text_en: having faith and a good conscience. By rejecting conscience, certain persons have suffered shipwreck in the faith;
text_cn: 保持信德和良心纯洁；有些人竟摈弃了良心，而在信德上遭了船破之灾；

text_en: among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have turned over to Satan, so that they may learn not to blaspheme.
text_cn: 其中有依默纳约和亚历山大，我已把他们交给撒殚，为叫他们学习不再亵渎。
